mechanisms.name: `rotationPolicy` default flips from `Never` to `Always` (breaking, affects us)
mechanisms.mechanism: The new default `Certificate.spec.privateKey.rotationPolicy: Always` (feature gate `DefaultPrivateKeyRotationPolicyAlways` on by default) applies to all three Certificates, none of which sets `rotationPolicy`. At the next renewal of `mesh-root-ca` a new root key is generated instead of reusing the old one; leaves signed by the old key do not validate against the new root. The `ca.crt` written into each leaf Secret is the issuing CA at issuance time and carries no old-root overlap. Leaves renew independently and staggered (720h duration, renewBefore 240h), so after a root rotation one side holds a `ca.crt` for the new root while the other still has a leaf from the old root, failing the handshake in both directions until each leaf renews (up to roughly 30 days). Nothing breaks at upgrade time; it is a delayed failure at the next renewal that a post-upgrade smoke test won't catch. Made worse by a runtime gap: `ledger` nginx reads cert/key/CA files only at startup or on SIGHUP and nothing in the repo triggers a reload or restart, so `ledger` keeps serving its old leaf and trusting its old CA until its pods restart (pre-existing weakness; rotation makes it fail in a new way). Leaf key rotation alone is low risk; remaining exposure is the nginx reload gap.
mechanisms.mitigationOrNoExposure: Not mitigated today. Proposed mitigations in order of preference: (1) add `privateKey.rotationPolicy: Never` to all three Certificates in the base manifests, merged before or together with the version bump, and before 1.19 where the gate goes GA and cannot be turned off; this is a no-op on 1.17.2; (2) optionally as a stopgap set `config.featureGates.DefaultPrivateKeyRotationPolicyAlways: false` in `values.yaml` (expires at 1.19); (3) longer term design root rotation deliberately: overlapping trust bundle (e.g. trust-manager, not present in repo), make `ledger` reload on Secret change, only then adopt `Always`.
citedEvidence: `upstream/.../release-notes-1.18.md` and `upgrading-1.17-1.18.md` document the flip; feature gate `DefaultPrivateKeyRotationPolicyAlways` on by default

mechanisms.mechanism: Direct Challenge resources can abuse ClusterIssuer DNS01 credentials; affected versions >= 1.18.0 and <= 1.20.2, patched only in 1.19.6 and 1.20.3, no 1.18.x fix; reproduced on v1.18.6.

overall.recommendation: Do not upgrade as-is; proceed with conditions: first land `privateKey.rotationPolicy: Never` on `mesh-root-ca`, `ledger-tls` and `checkout-tls`, run the staging rehearsal, then upgrade (preferably to 1.18.6) with a normal Argo sync; separately plan root rotation/trust distribution and a `ledger` reload mechanism before moving to `Always` and before 1.19.
